ravi: Quick flag  saw autofallback fire in prod but console only showed 'policy matched' with no metric context

mina: Can you share the request id? we should be able to pull the decision trace if captured

ravi: req=prod-3321. Trace missing. sampling coverage for that route shows ~8% because of the route telemetry short-circuit (qps>600)

carl: sounds like the usual sampler+quota interplay. UX ask: operator needs a compact explain (why) and a CTA to open full trace when available

anna: Proposal: always emit a tiny decision_summary (reason_code, rounded_value, threshold, mode, reroute_target, policy_ver, telemetry_coverage_est). Keep <1KB and no request inputs

ops-bot: deploy:autofallback 1766004350  feature flag 'decision_summary' enabled for prod-canary

mina: For customer-facing logs, send compact code only: FALLBACK:ER or FALLBACK:LAT and optional serving hint e.g. "serving=small-v2". No raw metrics

ravi: agree. Also add a per-org force_capture flag for canaries so decision_trace can be 100% for debugging

carl: infra note: summaries -> topic 'fallback_summaries' (30d hot), traces -> cold KMS store. Default full-trace budget: free=0.01%, paid=1%

anna: I'll draft proto and PR for the summary schema. will include telemetry_coverage_estimate and coverage_reason enum. Any objections?

mina: none. please tag me for UX copy review.

ravi: thanks 44d
